description: We Toxic Swaga and that's enough
summary: Abandoned but not Forgotten’ is an educational project in the form of an illustrated book, dedicated to the space equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars following the completion of NASA’s missions. In the book, we tell the stories of abandoned rovers, landers and other spacecraft, explaining how they worked and why they were left behind on other celestial bodies. Our aim is to reveal a little-known side of space exploration, to spark children’s interest in science and to remind them that even non-functioning spacecraft are part of human history.
